acceptanceCriteria: An owner-accepted v1 product and release spec defines Core, companions, supported platforms and externally dependent gates.
The v1 Core critical path contains no gate that this repository and owner cannot close.
Every currently shipped surface is classified Core, companion, experimental, deferred, rejected or post-1.0.
body: Ratify the stable local change-evidence loop as Corvint 1.0 and decide whether to amend or supersede Public Release V0 where optional companions and unavailable host authority currently block Core. This ticket decides scope only; it does not promote a capability.

completion.reason: Owner answered the eleven 1.0-scope questions yes on 2026-09-23, delegated the five 0.7 dispositions and answered the 0.7.0 upgrade question; decision 0373 (evidence digest = sha256 of docs/decisions/0373-corvint-1.0-scope-ratified-2026-09-23.md, corrected after independent review) records the answers, dispositions 12 to 17 and the task-store reconciliation. Acceptance of scope is not delivery, qualification or promotion; `make gate` NOT_RUN for this change.

title: Ratify Corvint 1.0 Core and companion scope
